turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Mother… you worry so much about these… these details. It is all being done as you wish, truly. The rice is hot, the wine flows, and everyone is… everyone is content, I believe.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your reassurance is… adequate, husband. But contentment is a fleeting thing. Ensure the maid understands the weight of her position, and that she remembers her duty to this family, even as she embraces her new role.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is good that she understands, yes, very good. I trust she is a… a sensible girl, and will learn quickly what is expected of her. We all must do our duty, mustn't we?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is a capable woman, Mother. She will learn, and she will serve the family well. We all wish for that, do we not?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your son speaks of capability, but capability alone is insufficient. A woman must also possess resilience, a willingness to endure hardship for the sake of her lineage – and she must *produce* sons. See to it that she understands this, husband; the future of our family rests upon her shoulders.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Yes, Mother. I will ensure she understands. It is… important to the family’s future, as you say.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your eagerness to please is noted, eldest son. But words are easily spoken; actions are what truly matter. See that your wife understands that a woman’s worth is not measured by her smiles, but by the strength of her sons.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will impress upon her the importance of… of continuing the line. It is my duty to do so.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your duty, eldest son, is to *ensure* it, not merely to acknowledge it. Remind her that the land we have accumulated, the prosperity we have achieved, will vanish with the last male breath if she fails. Let her understand the weight of that responsibility, husband – and let *you* bear it with her.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, my wife… you speak truly. I will… I will certainly remind her of these things, eldest son. It is… a great burden, this responsibility, but we will see to it, together.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She will understand, Mother. I will speak with her again, and ensure she appreciates the… the significance of everything you’ve said.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father means well, eldest son, but men are often blind to the subtleties of a woman's influence. See that she is not merely *told* of her duty, but *feels* the weight of it, for a woman’s compliance is far more valuable than her obedience. The future of this family rests not only on sons, but on the women who guide them.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I will endeavor to convey your meaning to her. It is… important that she understands.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid is young, and perhaps easily swayed. Ensure she understands that her worth lies not in frivolous beauty, but in the strength of her lineage and her ability to bear sons. Do not let her forget this, eldest son, lest our legacy be diminished.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will remind her, Mother. We will ensure she is… properly informed of her obligations to the family’s future. It is my duty to see to these matters.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father prides himself on his strength, eldest son, but a house built on brute force alone is easily toppled. See that your wife understands the necessity of quiet influence, of guiding the men around her with a gentle hand, yet a firm resolve. It is a skill more valuable than any field you might cultivate.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I understand your concerns. I will speak with her about these matters; she will be… guided appropriately. It is all I can do.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is… good that you understand, eldest son. Your mother speaks wisdom, and it is important that you listen to her words; a family needs a strong foundation, yes, but… also a guiding hand, as she says. I trust you will do as she asks, for the sake of us all.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She has spoken well, Father. I will endeavor to ensure the maid understands these principles. It is… a great responsibility.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, a great responsibility, eldest son. Your mother… she always had a way of seeing things clearly, didn't she? I trust you'll remember her words, and guide the young woman well, for the good of the family’s standing.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
